title: IDP-only sources are handed a combined-pool percentile but scored on the IDP-slice Hill master, so they vote ~48% of the anchor's value at the identical effective rank
subsystem: Core value blend — scope curve routing
claimUnderTest: CLAUDE.md step 3/5: 'Scope-appropriate curve routing (cross-market -> GLOBAL, overall IDP -> IDP, everything else -> OFFENSE)'; the dlfIdp registry entry says shared-market ladder translation 'correctly calibrates DLF against the retail offense market'. Both together assert every source's contribution lands in one 0-9999 coordinate system.
observed: `needs_shared_market_translation` rewrites an IDP-only source's rank into COMBINED-pool coordinates (dlfIdp/idpShow/fantasyProsIdp raw rank 1 -> effective rank 34 for Aidan Hutchinson, the same slot idpTradeCalc gives him). `_percentile_denom_for_source` then divides by 500 (combined-pool N) and `_curve_for_source` routes by SCOPE to the IDP master (c=0.0830) which was fit on IDPTradeCalc's IDP-only slice. The two coordinate systems are inconsistent: at percentile 0.0661 the IDP master pays 5627 while the value-direct anchor on the same row pays 6444. Measured over the whole board the four IDP-scope rank-signal sources contribute a median 0.461/0.474/0.481/0.485 of idpTradeCalc's contribution on the same row. On offense — where source rank space and curve space agree — every source clusters at 0.87-1.08 of the anchor. Re-scoring the SAME percentiles through the GLOBAL master (the curve fit on the combined pool the ladder maps into) returns median ratios 0.92/1.32/1.29/0.95.

numericProof.formula: V(p) = 9999 / (1 + (p/c)^s) evaluated at the SAME p for the IDP master vs the GLOBAL master

userImpact: Every IDP row's 'multi-source consensus' is dragged down by a units error rather than by disagreement: three sources that rank Aidan Hutchinson their #1 IDP are shown, in the /rankings value-chain panel, as valuing him 13% below the one source that ranks him 34th. A user reads real disagreement where the sources actually agree exactly, and sells IDP assets into a board biased low.

priorFinding.note: Prior said '~48% of the IDP market at the same rank'. Independently measured 46.1-48.5% median over 605 source votes on the 2026-08-04 board, plus the GLOBAL-curve counterfactual that isolates the mechanism.

whatWorks: The shared-market ladder translation itself is correct — it lands IDP rank 1 on exactly the combined-pool rank the anchor gives. Only the curve chosen afterwards is wrong.
rootCause: `_curve_for_source` routes on `scope`, while `_percentile_denom_for_source` and the ladder both operate in combined-pool space. Scope is the wrong key: what determines the right curve is which POOL the effective rank lives in, and after `needs_shared_market_translation` that pool is the combined one.
requiredRepair: Route any source whose effective rank has been ladder-translated into combined-pool space through the GLOBAL master (or, equivalently, key `_curve_for_source` on `sharedMarketTranslated`/`needs_rookie_translation` rather than on `scope`). Re-fit is not required — the GLOBAL master is already the combined-pool curve.
dependencies: Fixing this changes 52 anchor ejections (W02-F002) and most of the 127 corridor clamps (W02-F003); those two findings should be re-measured after, not fixed independently.
